mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 11 degrees now, scattered clouds. Next 24 hours: high 14, low 9.

Christine Lagarde must keep political neutrality until her term at the European Central Bank ends in February 2027, despite speculation that she could influence France's presidential election.

Brazil's Supreme Court rejected Ervin Mata's request to block his extradition to Albania, allowing the extradition process to proceed.

The municipal assembly of North Mitrovica voted to remove the "I love Mitrovica" sign that had been installed in the city, ending a recurring controversy.

Serbian parliamentary group leader Aleksandar Vučić was reprimanded in the National Assembly after delivering lengthy speeches that included insults toward the Student List.

Former Arsenal manager Arsène Wenger has revived his proposal to modify the off-side rule, suggesting that a player's body part could determine the position outside play.
